from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InstitutionAdmissionData(BaseModel):
    """Admission and enrollment statistics from a single institution's CDS report."""
    institution_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university/institution")
    admitted_first_year_students: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year admitted students")
    enrolled_first_year_students: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year enrolled students")
    reporting_term: str | None = Field(description="The academic term/year, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    institution_admission_data: list[InstitutionAdmissionData]
